purpose: Negative + boundary save. Tests: empty API key, whitespace-only API key, unknown provider id, unknown model id, switcher flip, unexpected extra key.

findings.empty_api_key: accepted, stored as empty string verbatim
findings.whitespace_api_key: accepted, stored as '   ' verbatim (no trim, no validation)
findings.unknown_provider_id: accepted, stored verbatim — no validation against registered providers list
findings.unknown_model_id: accepted, stored verbatim — no validation against provider model list
findings.switcher_flip: dokan_ai_image_gen_availability flipped on -> off accepted and round-trips
findings.unexpected_extra_key: PERSISTS in DB and response — server does not filter to schema. This explains how stale dokan_ai_chatgpt_* keys from earlier Dokan versions survived migrations.
findings.numeric_boundary_tests_skipped: Schema declares zero numeric fields for dokan_ai. The dokan_ai_max_tokens_for_marketplace key present in the pre-trace DB is a stale legacy key with no UI/schema control.
